entities.summary: The Basilica Shrine of Our Lady Mediatrix of All Graces or the Basilica of Santa Maria is a Catholic church dedicated to the Virgin Mary, located in Santa Maria municipality, Rio Grande do Sul, in the south of Brazil. It is the only basilica in the world dedicated to Mary the Mediatrix of all Graces.
